'''Vulna''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] and largest city of [[Seytinemas]], the sixteenth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city lies on the southern bank of the [[Lanol]] River and is the political, financial and cultural centre of [[Seytinemas]].

Vulna was the principal host city of the [[1740 FLLA World Cup]], the first FLLA World Cup contested in [[Mahea]] and the first under the present 32-team format. The Vulna Olympic Stadium hosted the opening match, one of the four quarter-finals, and the [[1740 FLLA World Cup#Final|final]] on 2 July 1740, in which [[New Misos]] defeated [[Lycroa]] 2–1 to win their first FLLA World Cup title. The 1740 final was the first FLLA World Cup match broadcast across all seven continents of [[Andah]] in real time by transcontinental radio relay.
